name: Watch list
title: Watch list: the films and shows you want to watch, are watching and have watched, with tonight's pick

permissions: keeps the person's watch list of films and shows: each title's details, their progress through a show's seasons and episodes, their own rating, notes and who recommended it
looks a title up by its words or its IMDb number in public sources with no account: IMDb's search suggestions, TVmaze, Wikidata and Wikipedia; nothing about the person is sent
downloads each title's poster once into the data directory and serves it from Rouh's own address
adds, marks, ticks, rates, notes and moves titles when the person asks in a chat or by voice (watch_list), and takes one off only on their own words
accounts: IMDb search suggestions, TVmaze, Wikidata and Wikipedia (public, no account)
